ImageDescription.value:
Freilichtmuseum Beuren (Beuren open-air museum) in Beuren near Nürtingen, Germany: the old bakehouse from Sulzgries, Esslingen, seen from the west.
The photo shows the bakehouse at the moment when the fire has just been lit: thick smoke streams from the chimney. To the right of the door is a pile of cut grapevines, which are used to start the fire; to the left under the bench is a bucket of water in case something goes wrong.
